rules.sentence: Vertebral compression fractures produce localized back pain that worsens with flexion and point tenderness on palpation.
Spinal stenosis is characterized by leg sensory and motor weakness that is relieved with rest (neurologic claudication).
Spinal tumors may present with unexplained weight loss, focal tenderness to palpation, or other risk factors for malignancy, with approximately 97% of spinal tumors being metastatic.[57]
Infections of the spine should be suspected in patients with a history of spinal surgery within the past 12 months, intravenous drug use, or immunosuppression.
Clinical features include fever, localized pain, tenderness, or spinal wounds.
Tuberculosis should be considered in patients from endemic regions.[58]
Acute or chronic aortic dissection can manifest as tearing back pain.
Vertebral fractures may result from trauma, prolonged corticosteroid use, or osteoporosis and are most common in patients older than 70.
Physical findings include contusions, abrasions, and tenderness over the spinous processes.
